shortDescription: Chile’s economic recovery could take longer because there are no clear signs that investment is rebounding, Central Bank Governor Rosanna Costa said in an interview with El Mercurio published on Sunday, according to Bloomberg.

title: Chile Central Bank Governor Rosanna Costa Says Recovery Could Take Longer
